description: Read a plan: every day in order with its steps (flights, rides with pickup times and estimates, hotel, the cruise, things to do), what's booked, item_ids, the estimated total, summary_markdown to show in the chat, and plan_url, the visual plan page to share. Read-only.
name: get_plan

name.description: The plan's name, e.g. "Alaska cruise · May 7–14": use it when the traveler has more than one plan.

plan_url.description: The visual plan page for the traveler. Share this link.

summary_markdown.description: A short day-by-day summary to show in the chat.

title: Get the trip plan
